text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp. Even with 
Daitaku Helios making a racket, Daiichi 
Ruby remains as composed as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby expresses her wish to make 
summer camp a fruitful one. It will surely 
be a crucial time, for she must decide on 
the path she will take next.
